title_vi: Nhấn mạnh: mệnh đề it và mệnh đề what
theory_html:
A. Focusing with it-clauses

A. Nhấn mạnh bằng mệnh đề it

We can use an it-clause with be to focus attention on the information that immediately follows it + (be). A sentence like this is sometimes called a cleft sentence. The clause after the it-clause (usually a that-clause) contains information that is already known or considered to be less important:

Có thể dùng mệnh đề it với be để tập trung chú ý vào thông tin ngay sau it + (be). Câu như vậy đôi khi gọi là câu chẻ. Mệnh đề sau mệnh đề it (thường là mệnh đề that) chứa thông tin đã biết hoặc ít quan trọng hơn:

  • ‘Lea bought the car from Olav.’ ‘No, it was Olav that bought the car from Lea.’

    ‘Lea mua xe của Olav.’ ‘Không, chính Olav mới là người mua xe của Lea.’

  • I don’t mind her criticising me, but it’s how she does it that I object to.

    Tôi không ngại cô ấy chỉ trích tôi, nhưng chính cách cô ấy làm mới khiến tôi phản đối.

  • It was to show how much I cared for her that I bought her the necklace.

    Chính để thể hiện tôi quan tâm cô ấy nhiều thế nào mà tôi mua chiếc vòng cổ.

We sometimes use which or who instead of that; when and where can also be used, but usually only in informal English; and note that how or why can’t replace that:

Đôi khi dùng which hoặc who thay cho that; when và where cũng dùng được, nhưng thường chỉ trong văn thân mật; lưu ý how hoặc why không thay được that:

  • Karl was always there to help her, and it was to him that / who she now turned for support.

    Karl luôn ở bên giúp cô ấy, và giờ chính anh ấy là người cô tìm đến để được hỗ trợ.

  • ‘Ida’s seriously ill in hospital.’ ‘But it was only last Sunday when / that I was playing tennis with her.’

    ‘Ida đang ốm nặng trong viện.’ ‘Nhưng mới Chủ nhật tuần trước thôi tôi còn chơi tennis với cô ấy.’

  • It was in Warsaw where / that the film was made.

    Chính ở Warsaw bộ phim được quay.

  • ‘Was it by cutting staff that he managed to save the firm?’ ‘No, it was by improving distribution that he made it profitable.’ (not … how he made it profitable.)

    ‘Có phải ông ấy cứu công ty bằng cách cắt giảm nhân sự?’ ‘Không, chính nhờ cải thiện phân phối mà ông ấy làm công ty có lãi.’

B. Focusing with what-clauses

B. Nhấn mạnh bằng mệnh đề what

We can also use a what-clause followed by be to focus attention on certain information in a sentence (= another form of cleft sentence). This pattern is particularly common in conversation. The information we want to focus attention on is outside the what-clause. Compare:

Cũng có thể dùng mệnh đề what + be để tập trung chú ý vào thông tin nhất định (= một dạng câu chẻ khác). Cấu trúc này đặc biệt phổ biến trong hội thoại. Thông tin cần nhấn mạnh nằm ngoài mệnh đề what. So sánh:

  • We gave them some home-made cake. / What we gave them was some home-made cake.

    Chúng tôi tặng họ bánh nhà làm. / Thứ chúng tôi tặng họ là bánh nhà làm.

We often do this if we want to introduce a new topic; to give a reason, instruction or explanation; or to correct something that has been said or done:

Ta thường làm vậy khi muốn giới thiệu chủ đề mới; đưa ra lý do, hướng dẫn hoặc giải thích; hoặc sửa điều đã nói hay làm:

  • What I’d like you to work on is the revision exercise on the website.

    Điều tôi muốn các em làm là bài ôn tập trên trang web.

  • Isa arrived two hours late: what had happened was that his bicycle chain had broken.

    Isa đến muộn hai tiếng: chuyện là xích xe đạp của anh ấy bị đứt.

  • ‘We’ve only got this small bookcase – will that do?’ ‘No, what I was looking for was something much bigger and stronger.’

    ‘Chúng tôi chỉ có cái giá sách nhỏ này – được không?’ ‘Không, thứ tôi đang tìm là cái gì đó to và chắc hơn nhiều.’

We can often put the what-clause either at the beginning or the end of the sentence:

Thường có thể đặt mệnh đề what ở đầu hoặc cuối câu:

  • What upset me most was his rudeness. / His rudeness was what upset me most.

    Điều làm tôi buồn nhất là sự thô lỗ của anh ta.

To focus attention on an action performed by someone, we use a sentence with what + subject + do + be + to-infinitive clause. We can’t use an it-clause to do this:

Để nhấn mạnh hành động ai đó thực hiện, dùng what + chủ ngữ + do + be + mệnh đề to-infinitive. Không thể dùng mệnh đề it cho mục đích này:

  • Luis lost his job and was short of money, so what he did was (to) sell his flat and move in with his brother. (not … so it was (to) sell his flat that he did.)

    Luis mất việc và thiếu tiền, nên việc anh ấy làm là bán căn hộ và chuyển đến ở với anh trai.

C. Nouns instead of other wh-words

C. Danh từ thay cho các từ wh- khác

The pattern in B is only usually used with what-clauses. Instead of placing other wh-clauses (beginning how, when, where, who, why) at the beginning of the sentence we prefer to use a noun which has a meaning related to the wh-word (e.g. reason rather than why; place rather than where) followed by a that- or wh-clause:

Cấu trúc ở B thường chỉ dùng với mệnh đề what. Thay vì đặt các mệnh đề wh- khác (how, when, where, who, why) ở đầu câu, ta thích dùng danh từ có nghĩa liên quan (vd. reason thay cho why; place thay cho where) + mệnh đề that hoặc wh-:

  • The only reason (why / that) I left the party early was that I was feeling unwell. (rather than Why I left the party early was …)

    Lý do duy nhất tôi rời tiệc sớm là vì tôi thấy không khỏe.

  • The place (where / that) you should play football is the playground, not the classroom.

    Chỗ để chơi bóng là sân chơi, không phải lớp học.

  • Somebody (who / that) I enjoy reading is Peter Carey.

    Một tác giả tôi thích đọc là Peter Carey.

  • The time (when / that) I work best is early morning.

    Thời điểm tôi làm việc hiệu quả nhất là sáng sớm.

mcq.question: ‘Lea bought the car from Olav.’ ‘No, ___ Olav that bought the car from Lea.’
mcq.full: ‘Lea bought the car from Olav.’ ‘No, it was Olav that bought the car from Lea.’
mcq.vi: ‘Lea mua xe của Olav.’ ‘Không, chính Olav mới là người mua xe của Lea.’
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that.
mcq.key: ‘Lea bought the car from Olav.’ ‘No, ___ Olav that bought the car from Lea.’|it was

mcq.question: I don’t mind her criticising me, but it’s how she does it ___ I object to.
mcq.full: I don’t mind her criticising me, but it’s how she does it that I object to.
mcq.vi: Tôi không ngại cô ấy chỉ trích, nhưng chính cách cô ấy làm mới khiến tôi phản đối.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it-clause … that.
mcq.key: I don’t mind her criticising me, but it’s how she does it ___ I object to.|that

mcq.question: It was to show how much I cared for her ___ I bought her the necklace.
mcq.full: It was to show how much I cared for her that I bought her the necklace.
mcq.vi: Chính để thể hiện tôi quan tâm cô ấy nhiều thế nào mà tôi mua chiếc vòng cổ.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không dùng why thay that.
mcq.key: It was to show how much I cared for her ___ I bought her the necklace.|that

mcq.question: Karl was always there to help her, and it was to him ___ she now turned for support.
mcq.full: Karl was always there to help her, and it was to him that she now turned for support.
mcq.vi: Karl luôn ở bên giúp cô ấy, và giờ chính anh ấy là người cô tìm đến.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it was to him that / who.
mcq.key: Karl was always there to help her, and it was to him ___ she now turned for support.|that

mcq.question: It was in Warsaw ___ the film was made.
mcq.full: It was in Warsaw that the film was made.
mcq.vi: Chính ở Warsaw mà bộ phim được quay.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it-clause … that (thân mật: where).
mcq.key: It was in Warsaw ___ the film was made.|that

mcq.question: No, it was by improving distribution ___ he made it profitable.
mcq.full: No, it was by improving distribution that he made it profitable.
mcq.vi: Không, chính nhờ cải thiện phân phối mà ông ấy làm công ty có lãi.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không dùng how thay that.
mcq.key: No, it was by improving distribution ___ he made it profitable.|that

mcq.question: Mark’s known for ages that his parents are coming, but it was only yesterday ___ he told me.
mcq.full: Mark’s known for ages that his parents are coming, but it was only yesterday that he told me.
mcq.vi: Mark biết từ lâu bố mẹ sẽ đến, nhưng mãi hôm qua anh ấy mới nói với tôi.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it was only yesterday that / when.
mcq.key: Mark’s known for ages that his parents are coming, but it was only yesterday ___ he told me.|that

mcq.question: Helena has been feeling a bit depressed, so it was to cheer her up ___ I booked a holiday in Amsterdam.
mcq.full: Helena has been feeling a bit depressed, so it was to cheer her up that I booked a holiday in Amsterdam.
mcq.vi: Helena hơi buồn chán, nên chính để cô ấy vui lên mà tôi đặt kỳ nghỉ ở Amsterdam.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it-clause … that (không why).
mcq.key: Helena has been feeling a bit depressed, so it was to cheer her up ___ I booked a holiday in Amsterdam.|that

mcq.question: It’s not that I don’t want to have dinner with you; it’s because I’ve got so much work to do ___ I can’t come.
mcq.full: It’s not that I don’t want to have dinner with you; it’s because I’ve got so much work to do that I can’t come.
mcq.vi: Không phải tôi không muốn ăn tối với bạn; chính vì tôi quá nhiều việc nên không đến được.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it’s because … that.
mcq.key: It’s not that I don’t want to have dinner with you; it’s because I’ve got so much work to do ___ I can’t come.|that

mcq.question: She doesn’t find learning languages easy, and it was only by studying very hard ___ she improved her Spanish.
mcq.full: She doesn’t find learning languages easy, and it was only by studying very hard that she improved her Spanish.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy học ngoại ngữ không dễ, và chỉ nhờ học rất chăm mà cô cải thiện được tiếng Tây Ban Nha.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it-clause … that.
mcq.key: She doesn’t find learning languages easy, and it was only by studying very hard ___ she improved her Spanish.|that

mcq.question: I have had a great deal of help from my family, and it is to my family ___ I dedicate this thesis.
mcq.full: I have had a great deal of help from my family, and it is to my family that I dedicate this thesis.
mcq.vi: Tôi được gia đình giúp đỡ rất nhiều, và chính gia đình là người tôi dành tặng luận án này.
mcq.expl:
It + be + focus + that / who / which (informally when / where) + rest of sentence; not how / why for that.
It + be + phần nhấn mạnh + that / who / which (thân mật: when / where) + phần còn lại; không dùng how / why thay that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it is to … that.
mcq.key: I have had a great deal of help from my family, and it is to my family ___ I dedicate this thesis.|that

mcq.question: ___ we gave them was some home-made cake.
mcq.full: What we gave them was some home-made cake.
mcq.vi: Thứ chúng tôi tặng họ là bánh nhà làm.
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: What-clause + be.
mcq.key: ___ we gave them was some home-made cake.|What

mcq.question: ___ I’d like you to work on is the revision exercise on the website.
mcq.full: What I’d like you to work on is the revision exercise on the website.
mcq.vi: Điều tôi muốn các em làm là bài ôn tập trên trang web.
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: What-clause giới thiệu hướng dẫn.
mcq.key: ___ I’d like you to work on is the revision exercise on the website.|What

mcq.question: Isa arrived two hours late: what had happened ___ that his bicycle chain had broken.
mcq.full: Isa arrived two hours late: what had happened was that his bicycle chain had broken.
mcq.vi: Isa đến muộn hai tiếng: chuyện là xích xe đạp của anh ấy bị đứt.
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: what had happened was that.
mcq.key: Isa arrived two hours late: what had happened ___ that his bicycle chain had broken.|was

mcq.question: No, what I was looking for ___ something much bigger and stronger.
mcq.full: No, what I was looking for was something much bigger and stronger.
mcq.vi: Không, thứ tôi đang tìm là cái gì đó to và chắc hơn nhiều.
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: What-clause + be.
mcq.key: No, what I was looking for ___ something much bigger and stronger.|was

mcq.question: His rudeness was ___ upset me most.
mcq.full: His rudeness was what upset me most.
mcq.vi: Sự thô lỗ của anh ta là điều làm tôi buồn nhất.
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: focus + be + what-clause.
mcq.key: His rudeness was ___ upset me most.|what

mcq.question: Luis lost his job, so what he did ___ sell his flat and move in with his brother.
mcq.full: Luis lost his job, so what he did was sell his flat and move in with his brother.
mcq.vi: Luis mất việc, nên việc anh ấy làm là bán căn hộ và chuyển đến ở với anh trai.
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: what + S + do + be + (to) infinitive.
mcq.key: Luis lost his job, so what he did ___ sell his flat and move in with his brother.|was

mcq.question: ‘Did you say that Rudi was going to live in Austria?’ ‘No, what I said ___ that he was going on holiday to Austria.’
mcq.full: ‘Did you say that Rudi was going to live in Austria?’ ‘No, what I said was that he was going on holiday to Austria.’
mcq.vi: ‘Bạn nói Rudi sẽ sống ở Áo à?’ ‘Không, điều tôi nói là anh ấy đi nghỉ ở Áo.’
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: what I said was that.
mcq.key: ‘Did you say that Rudi was going to live in Austria?’ ‘No, what I said ___ that he was going on holiday to Austria.’|was

mcq.question: ‘Do you hope to sell your Picasso paintings?’ ‘No, what I hope ___ that they will be put into a public art gallery.’
mcq.full: ‘Do you hope to sell your Picasso paintings?’ ‘No, what I hope is that they will be put into a public art gallery.’
mcq.vi: ‘Bạn có định bán tranh Picasso không?’ ‘Không, điều tôi mong là chúng được đưa vào phòng trưng bày công cộng.’
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: what I hope is that.
mcq.key: ‘Do you hope to sell your Picasso paintings?’ ‘No, what I hope ___ that they will be put into a public art gallery.’|is

mcq.question: ‘Did it annoy you that Carla came so late?’ ‘No, what annoyed me was that she ___ apologise.’
mcq.full: ‘Did it annoy you that Carla came so late?’ ‘No, what annoyed me was that she didn’t apologise.’
mcq.vi: ‘Carla đến muộn thế có làm bạn bực không?’ ‘Không, điều làm tôi bực là cô ấy không xin lỗi.’
mcq.expl:
What-clause + be + focus (or focus + be + what-clause); for actions: what + subject + do + be + (to) infinitive (not an it-clause).
Mệnh đề what + be + phần nhấn mạnh (hoặc phần nhấn mạnh + be + mệnh đề what); cho hành động: what + chủ ngữ + do + be + (to) nguyên mẫu (không dùng mệnh đề it).
Điểm ngữ pháp: what annoyed me was that.
mcq.key: ‘Did it annoy you that Carla came so late?’ ‘No, what annoyed me was that she ___ apologise.’|didn’t

mcq.question: ‘Did you watch the football on TV last night?’ ‘No, what I did was ___ my brother to record it.’
mcq.full: ‘Did you watch the football on TV last night?’ ‘No, what I did was to get my brother to record it.’
mcq.vi: ‘Tối qua bạn có xem bóng đá không?’ ‘Không, việc tôi làm là nhờ anh trai ghi lại.’
